scope: Phase 2 qualitative public web observations, not localized rank tracking or keyword volume measurement
preservation: All existing nationwide state/city coverage preserved; no public pages modified
method: Public search on service-intent phrases; evidence is provider primary pages surfaced in search, not fixed-geo device-controlled top-ten ranks.
